title: Geologic map of the Aiken NW quadrangle, Aiken and Edgefield Counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., 1984, Geologic map of the Aiken NW quadrangle, Aiken and Edgefield Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-39, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Map sheet whose explanation lists unit names only (no descriptions, ages or thicknesses). Map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page image (OCR garbled several). The Piedmont unit (Pu) is exposed along valleys in the north of the map. SCGS drill-hole labels on the map face (2-xxx) carry no logs and were not recorded. No references, structures or cross section. SUBSURFACE: none.
Map sheet whose explanation lists unit names only (no descriptions, ages or thicknesses). Map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page image (OCR garbled several). The Piedmont unit (Pu) is exposed along valleys in the north of the map. SCGS drill-hole labels read from the map face on page images (no logs printed; 2-922 in the explanation is the legend sample only and is not recorded). Lettered labels (2-004A to 2-004D, 2-083A,B) recorded as printed. No references, structures or cross section. SUBSURFACE: none.
